title: A Sixkey rules bundle downloaded between releases, schema 1
description: Site rules only, and all of them: in effect, it replaces the baseline's rules and hosts whole, so a rule can be taken out between releases. It never carries aliases, appends or upstream: those ship with releases, so a signed download cannot make Sixkey say that a page and an account's site are the same sign-in. Sixkey's checker (extension/src/core/rules/format.ts) also checks what this schema cannot, as for baseline.schema.json.

version.description: A counter: each release's baseline and each published bundle takes the next one.

source.description: Where the source of this bundle is: an https address, never empty (the rules in it may be anyone's, so AGPL asks for it).

hosts.description: Each exact host, and the id of its rule. Every rule has at least one host and at most 16.

host.description: A host name as a URL parser writes it (lower case, punycode, no trailing dot or port), of two labels or more. Sixkey's checker also refuses IP addresses, shared suffixes (co.uk, github.io, ...) and, in a store build's bundle, the reserved names .test, .example, .invalid and .localhost.

path.description: A literal prefix of location.pathname as the browser gives it (percent-encoded, case-sensitive): printable ASCII without what a browser always percent-encodes in a path (space, " # < > ? \ ^ ` { }) and without *, which is no wildcard here.

segments.description: 0: one box; 4 to 8: exactly that many boxes, in document order, form the code's group.

fill.description: The group's strategy; one box takes "auto" only.

selector.description: Compound selectors joined by exactly one space (descendant) or " > " (child). A compound: an optional type, then any of #id, .class, [name], [name="value"], [name^="value"], [name~="word"]. Ids and classes are CSS identifiers without escapes (an optional -, then a letter or _, then letters, digits, _ and -); a value is printable ASCII without '"' or '\\', a word the same without spaces and not empty. No pseudo-classes, :has(), lists, *, ~ or + combinators. At most one #id per compound (Sixkey's checker).

minLeft.description: Seconds of the code's period that must remain to fill it on this site (default 5, never more than half the period).
